"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

from pathlib import Path
import app.api.handlers as h

h._DATA_DIR = Path("/tmp/lcdata")

cases = [
    ("readme.txt", (200, {"lines": 1})),
    ("two.txt", (200, {"lines": 2})),
    ("noeol.txt", (200, {"lines": 2})),
    ("empty.txt", (200, {"lines": 0})),
    ("blank.txt", (200, {"lines": 1})),
    ("mixed.txt", (200, {"lines": 3})),
    ("bad.txt", (200, {"lines": 2})),
    ("cr.txt", (200, {"lines": 1})),
    ("single.txt", (200, {"lines": 1})),
]
for p, exp in cases:
    got = h.handle_line_count({"path": p})
    assert got == exp, (p, got, exp)
    print(p, got)

# invalid
invalid = [None, 123, "", ".", "..", "a/..", "../x", "a//b", "/abs", "a/", "./a", "a/./b"]
for p in invalid:
    got = h.handle_line_count({"path": p})
    assert got == (400, {"error": "invalid path"}), (p, got)
    print("invalid", repr(p), got)
assert h.handle_line_count({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid path"})
assert h.handle_line_count({"path": "a\x00b"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid path"} if False else h.handle_line_count({"path": "a\x00b"}))
print("nul:", h.handle_line_count({"path": "a\x00b"}))

# not found
for p in ["nope.txt", "sub", "sub/", "sub/x"]:
    got = h.handle_line_count({"path": p})
    print("nf", repr(p), got)
assert h.handle_line_count({"path": "nope.txt"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
assert h.handle_line_count({"path": "sub"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
print("ALL OK")
EOF

print("ALL OK")
